// REQ: LANG-2031 LANG-2032 LANG-2033 LANG-2034
let
    // Load and filter
    Source = Csv.Document(File.Contents("data.csv"), [Delimiter = ","]),
    Filtered = Table.SelectRows(Source, each [Age] > 18 and true),
    Added = Table.AddColumn(Filtered, "Greeting", each "Hello, " & [Name] & "!", type text)
in
    Added
